trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 30,000 AI credits, 5 lists and 5 projects per month
trials.claimQuote:
30,000 AI credits per month
- 5 lists per month
- 5 projects per month
trials.reasoning: Reviews show one AI project can cost 20,000 to 50,000 credits and credits run out after a few pages, so the 30,000 monthly credits may not actually allow 5 projects per month.

exhibits.quote: Even on Tier 4, generating a single project via AI can cost between 20,000 to 50,000 credits or more.
exhibits.argument: A single project can consume the entire monthly credit allowance, undermining the promised 5 lists and 5 projects per month.

exhibits.quote: After a few pages of looking through ideas, I got a message that my credit ran out.
exhibits.argument: Credits run out before any real project is done, undermining that 30,000 credits covers the monthly usage.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes 60,000 AI credits, 10 lists and 10 projects per month

- 10 projects per month

exhibits.quote: Consequently, with a total of approximately 120,000 credits, one can typically complete only about 6 to 9 projects.
exhibits.argument: Even double the credits yields only a few projects, undermining that 60,000 credits covers 10 lists and 10 projects per month.
